page.overview:
Who is Ludmilla?

Ludmilla was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Ludmilla and her sister were summonded their parents, with their father Hadyn chastising them for addressing their mother as if she were a commoner. As they prepared to leave for the arena, the girls were angry to learn that Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen would not be present, instead travelling to Rossak as part of a hunting party. They no longer wished to go, but Hadyn ordered them to, as he had imported their dresses from Chusuk. He told them that they had no chance with Feyd, whose mate would be chosen for political advantage alone.

There was a knock at the door, which Hadyn to reveal Davros, who announced that he had grim tidings. The girls were dismissed while their parents spoke with Davros. They later departed for the arena in their groundcar. As they travelled through the the backway, Ludmilla complained that she needed to urinate, with Hadyn criticising her for not doing so before they left. An announcement came on the Communinet Radio announcing the death of Argus Veer and a riot that had broken out as a result. The girls were afraid, but their father assured them that their groundcar would protect them. However, Davros informed him that the riot had escalated into a full scale revolt, causing Hadyn to upset the girls by declaring that he hated every member of House Harkonnen.
